ns2:course.label: Multinational Management
ns2:course.description: Examines critical issues facing managers who work in multinational firms. Designed to develop students' skills for working in a global business environment. Topics include foreign market entry strategies, global management of the functional areas of business, and management and control of multinational firms in the global marketplace.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
